summary: Completed backend pytest and frontend Playwright validation for ClearPath MVP + Phase 2/3 preview. Core auth, onboarding, dashboard, schools/courses/lessons, journal/check-ins, AI chat, plans, support, and responsive navigation flows are working on public URL.
action_items: Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with reusable admin and student credentials (required by test workflow).
Add explicit frontend error handling states for key API-driven pages (many useEffect calls currently have no catch/error UI).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth test credential source is effectively missing: /app/memory/test_credentials.md only has placeholder comments, which blocks deterministic admin-flow retesting.
Several critical pages (Dashboard, Schools, AIProfessors, Support, Admin, etc.) call APIs in useEffect without catch handlers; failures can silently degrade UX and complicate RCA.
Onboarding submit action lacks try/catch and user-visible failure messaging, risking stuck UX on API/network errors.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated test users via /api/auth/register using @example.com addresses during backend and UI tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is ready at /app/backend/tests/test_mvp_core_flows.py (10 tests passing). Initial AI UI check failed due to brittle selector expectation (assumed ai-message-1 after existing chat history); focused retry confirmed AI send/response works. Non-admin users are redirected from /admin to /dashboard as expected.
rca of the issue: Observed AI UI false negative in first Playwright run: assertion targeted a fixed selector ([data-testid=ai-message-1]) but chat history can already contain prior messages, making index-based selector non-deterministic. Mitigation: assert message count increase or assistant content presence instead of fixed message index.
test_credentials: Missing usable credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (placeholder file only).
